arxiv-2012-08600.title: Search for supersymmetry in final states with two oppositely charged same-flavor leptons and missing transverse momentum in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2012-08600.description: Abstract A search for phenomena beyond the standard model in final states with two oppositely charged same-flavor leptons and missing transverse momentum is presented. The search uses a data sample of proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV , corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 137 ​ \fbinv 137\fbinv , collected by the CMS experiment at the LHC.

arxiv-2101-03712.title: Enumeration Algorithms for Conjunctive Queries with Projection Thanks: We are grateful to the reviewers for a careful reading of the manuscript and their feedback.
arxiv-2101-03712.creator: Shaleen Deep ORCID:0000-0003-2342-4060, Xiao Hu ORCID:0000-0002-7890-665X, Paraschos Koutris ORCID:0000-0001-6309-1702
arxiv-2101-03712.description: Abstract . We investigate the enumeration of query results for an important subset of CQs with projections, namely star and path queries. The task is to design data structures and algorithms that allow for efficient enumeration with delay guarantees after a preprocessing phase.

arxiv-2105-13050.title: Line Marching Algorithm For Planar Kinematic Swarm Robots: A Dynamic Leader-Follower Approach
arxiv-2105-13050.creator: He Cai a , Shuping Guo a , Yuheng He a , Jieyi Yan a , Yingnan Zhen a , Huanli Gao a , and Xiangyang Li a
arxiv-2105-13050.description: Abstract Most of the existing formation algorithms for multiagent systems are fully label-specified, i.e., the desired position for each agent in the formation is uniquely determined by its label, which would inevitably make the formation algorithms vulnerable to agent failures.

arxiv-2205-09421.title: Dual-Mode Chirp Spread Spectrum Modulation
arxiv-2205-09421.creator: Ali Waqar Azim, Ahmad Bazzi, Raed Shubair, Marwa Chafii
arxiv-2205-09421.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ali Waqar Azim, Ahmad Bazzi, Raed Shubair, Marwa Chafii. In this letter, we propose dual-mode chirp spread spectrum (DM-CSS) modulation for low-power wide-area networks. DM-CSS is capable of achieving a higher spectral efficiency (SE) relative to its counterparts, such as Long Range (LoRa) modulation.

arxiv-2405-17547.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alessandro Savino, Mario Gennaro, Andrew E. Dolphin, Daniel R. Weisz, Matteo Correnti, Jay Anderson, Rachael Beaton, Martha L. Boyer, Roger E. Cohen, Andrew A. Cole, Meredith J. Durbin, Christopher T. Garling, Marla C. Geha, Karoline M. Gilbert, Jason Kalirai, Nitya Kallivayalil, Kristen B. W. McQui. We empirically assess estimates from v3.0 of the JWST NIRCam Exposure Time Calculator (ETC) using observations of resolved stars in Local Group targets taken as part of the Resolved Stellar Populations Early Release Science (ERS) Program.

arxiv-2407-06576.title: Virtual Personas for Language Models via an Anthology of Backstories
arxiv-2407-06576.creator: Suhong Moon * Marwa Abdulhai * Minwoo Kang * Joseph Suh *
arxiv-2407-06576.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Suhong Moon * Marwa Abdulhai * Minwoo Kang * Joseph Suh *. Large language models (LLMs) are trained from vast repositories of text authored by 100s of millions of distinct authors, reflecting an enormous diversity of human traits. While these models could potentially model a variety of human behaviors, most prior work has focused on predicting behaviors of groups of subjects, or have relied on a small set of short hand-written “personas”.

arxiv-2504-21393.title: JAvaScript Multimodal INformation Explorer
arxiv-2504-21393.creator: Fenja Schweder, Sebastian Trujillo-Gomez, Kai Polsterer
arxiv-2504-21393.description: Abstract Astronomical data is rich in volume, information and facets. Although this offers multiple research perspectives, processing the data remains a challenge. Infrastructures for analyzing, inspecting, exploring and communicating with data are mandatory. To address this issue, we introduce Jasmine, the JAvaScript Multimodal INformation Explorer.

arxiv-2509-04205.title: Toward precision physics tests with future COHERENT detectors
arxiv-2509-04205.creator: M. Atzori Corona, M. Cadeddu, N. Cargioli, F. Dordei, C. Giunti, R. Pavarani
arxiv-2509-04205.description: Abstract We present a comprehensive sensitivity study of future CE ν \nu NS detectors, focusing on a cryogenic cesium iodide detector and a tonne-scale liquid argon one, currently being developed by the COHERENT Collaboration. These setups will enable precision measurements of the weak mixing angle at low energies and allow accurate extraction of the neutron nuclear distribution radius.

arxiv-2512-07608.title: Metric-Fair Prompting: Treating Similar Samples Similarly
arxiv-2512-07608.creator: Jing Wang, Jie Shen, Xing Niu, Tong Zhang, Jeremy Weiss
arxiv-2512-07608.description: Abstract We introduce Metric-Fair Prompting , a fairness-aware prompting framework that guides large language models (LLMs) to make decisions under metric-fairness constraints. In the application of multiple-choice medical question answering, each (question, option) pair is treated as a binary instance with label + 1 +1 (correct) or − 1 -1 (incorrect).

arxiv-2601-11705.title: String Theory from Maximal Supersymmetry
arxiv-2601-11705.creator: Henriette Elvang, Aidan Herderschee, Roger Morales
arxiv-2601-11705.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Henriette Elvang, Aidan Herderschee, Roger Morales. We explore the space of non-gravitational, maximally supersymmetric, planar 4d effective field theories (EFTs) that have 𝒩 = 4 \mathcal{N}=4 super Yang–Mills (SYM) at leading order. We show that in the weakly-coupled regime, highly non-trivial nonlinear constraints on the 4-point Wilson coefficients follow from enforcing 𝒩 = 4 \mathcal{N}=4 supersymmetry and S ​ U ​ ( 4 ) SU(4) R-symmetry together with the requirement of standard tree-level factorization on the massless poles of the 4-, 5-, and 6-point

arxiv-2601-16393.title: GNSS-based Lunar Orbit and Clock Estimation With Stochastic Cloning UD Filter
arxiv-2601-16393.creator: Keidai Iiyama and Grace Gao
arxiv-2601-16393.description: Abstract This paper presents a terrestrial GNSS–based orbit and clock estimation framework for lunar navigation satellites. To enable high-precision estimation under the low-observability conditions encountered at lunar distances, we develop a stochastic-cloning UD-factorized filter and delayed-state smoother that provide enhanced numerical stability when processing precise time-differenced carrier phase (TDCP) measurements.

arxiv-2602-11162.title: Retrieval Heads are Dynamic
arxiv-2602-11162.creator: Yuping Lin, Zitao Li, Yue Xing, Pengfei He, Yingqian Cui, Yaliang Li, Bolin Ding, Jingren Zhou, Jiliang Tang
arxiv-2602-11162.description: Abstract Recent studies have identified “retrieval heads” in Large Language Models (LLMs) responsible for extracting information from input contexts. However, prior works largely rely on static statistics aggregated across datasets, identifying heads that perform retrieval on average. This perspective overlooks the fine-grained temporal dynamics of autoregressive generation. In this paper, we investigate retrieval heads from a dynamic perspective.

arxiv-2602-19056.title: Affine logic with the integration operator
arxiv-2602-19056.description: Abstract Affine continuous logic is extended to affine integration logic. Affine compactness theorem is proved by both the ultramean construction and Henkin’s method. Also, a proof system and a completeness theorem are given. An appropriate variant of the Keisler-Shelah isomorphism theorem holds in this setting.

arxiv-2602-20045.title: Dual Security for MIMO-OFDM ISAC Systems: Artificial Ghosts or Artificial Noise
arxiv-2602-20045.creator: Yinchao Yang, Prabhat Raj Gautam, Yathreb Bouazizi, Michael Breza, Julie McCann
arxiv-2602-20045.description: Abstract Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables the efficient sharing of wireless resources to support emerging applications, but it also gives rise to new sensing-based security vulnerabilities. Here, potential communication security threats whereby confidential messages intended for legitimate users are intercepted, but also unauthorized receivers (Eves) can passively exploit target echoes to infer sensing parameters without users being aware.

pmc-10547760.title: Effect of oxygen vacancy and Si doping on the electrical properties of Ta2O5 in memristor characteristics
pmc-10547760.creator: Md Sherajul Islam, Jonghoon Lee, Sabyasachi Ganguli, Ajit K Roy
pmc-10547760.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The resistive switching behavior in Ta2O5 based memristors is largely controlled by the formation and annihilation of conductive filaments (CFs) that are generated by the migration of oxygen vacancies (OVs). To gain a fundamental insight on the switching characteristics, we have systematically investigated the electrical transport properties of two different Ta2O5 polymorphs (ϵ-Ta2O5 and λ-Ta2O5), using density functional theory calculations, and associated vacancy induced electrical conductivity using Boltzmann transport theory.

pmc-10574014.title: Diaphragm Fatigue in SMNΔ7 Mice and Its Molecular Determinants: An Underestimated Issue
pmc-10574014.creator: Francesca Cadile, Deborah Recchia, Massimiliano Ansaldo, Paola Rossi, Giorgia Rastelli, Simona Boncompagni, Lorenza Brocca, Maria Antonietta Pellegrino, Monica Canepari
pmc-10574014.description: Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) is a genetic disorder characterized by the loss of spinal motor neurons leading to muscle weakness and respiratory failure. Mitochondrial dysfunctions are found in the skeletal muscle of patients with SMA. For obvious ethical reasons, the diaphragm muscle is poorly studied, notwithstanding the very important role that respiratory involvement plays in SMA mortality.

pmc-10612345.title: Composition of pathogenic microorganism in chronic osteomyelitis based on metagenomic sequencing and its application value in etiological diagnosis
pmc-10612345.creator: Kang Zhang, Yu-zhe Bai, Chang Liu, Shan-shan Liu, Xin-xin Lu, Run-gong Yang
pmc-10612345.description: BackgroundTraditionally, conventional microbiological culture methods have been used to detect pathogenic microorganisms in chronic osteomyelitis. However, these methods have been found to have a low detection rate, complicating the precise guidance of infection treatment. This study employed metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) to detect these microorganisms in chronic osteomyelitis with three main objectives: 1).

pmc-10745298.title: Biological Activity of Canned Pork Meat Fortified Black Currant Leaf Extract: In Vitro, In Silico, and Molecular Docking Study
pmc-10745298.creator: Karolina M. Wójciak, Paulina Kęska
pmc-10745298.description: The aim of this study was to assess the antioxidant and inhibiting (ACE-I, DPP IV, and alpha-glucosidase) potential of canned meat featuring reduced sodium nitrate content (50 mg/kg) and fortified with freeze-dried currant leaf extract. Research indicates that employing a lyophilizate dose of 150 mg/kg yields optimal benefits in terms of the antioxidant activity of the meat product.

pmc-11684497.title: Misuse of Guidelines Could Disadvantage and Harm Patients
pmc-11684497.creator: Ernest W Lau, Hendrik Bonnemeier, Benito Baldauf
pmc-11684497.description: experience more harm than benefit become the contra‐indications (Class III). RCTs involving human participants could not be designed to show a treatment is ineffective or harmful by the Declaration of Helsinki [1]. All the contra‐indications known for a treatment are from either totally unexpected outcomes from RCTs or rare adverse events that only emerge under long term surveillance.

pmc-11688772.title: VICTIMIZATION EXPERIENCES AND COGNITIVE HEALTH: VARIATION BY SEXUAL MINORITY STATUS
pmc-11688772.creator: Harry Barbee
pmc-11688772.description: Studies have revealed how experiences of victimization generate stress and harm cognitive health outcomes. For minority populations, such as sexual minorities, victimization experiences may occur more frequently, thus posing a greater risk to their cognitive health outcomes in later life stages.

pmc-12408423.title: A bibliometric analysis and mapping of global research trends in antihypertensive medication adherence (1975–2024)
pmc-12408423.creator: Mokanpally Sandeep, M. Surya Durga Prasad, Sree Sudha Tanguturi Yella, Dandge Shailendra, B. R. Shamanna
pmc-12408423.description: BackgroundHypertension, a significant risk factor for cardiovascular diseases, has increased dramatically over the decades. It can be mitigated with proper medication utilization and lifestyle modifications. Adherence to antihypertensive medication plays a significant role in reducing severe complications and improving the overall quality of life of people living with hypertension.

pmc-12433216.title: Pharmacokinetic and Safety Profiles of MIT-001, a Novel Ferroptosis Inhibitor, After Subcutaneous Administration in Healthy Participants
pmc-12433216.creator: Sujong Lee, Sungyeun Bae, Kyung-Sang Yu, SeungHwan Lee
pmc-12433216.description: PurposeMIT-001 is a novel ferroptosis inhibitor with therapeutic potential for oxidative stress-related diseases. This study aimed to evaluate the pharmacokinetic (PK) and safety profiles of MIT-001 after subcutaneous (SC) administration in healthy participants.MethodsA randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, dose-escalation study was conducted in two parts: single ascending dose (SAD) and multiple ascending dose (MAD) studies.

pmc-12607846.title: Acute Kidney Injury Induces Lung Damage via Mitochondrial DAMPs by Activating TREM-1 and cGAS-STING Pathways
pmc-12607846.creator: Zhi Tian, Runze Ni, Nadezhda N Zheleznova, Diane Allen-Gipson, Lei Wang, Vijay Subramanian, Kiran Dhanireddy, Sarah Y Yuan, Nohely Hernandez Soto, Jose D Herazo-Maya, Kristof Williams, Isabella Lozonschi, Andrew Bedard, Gabrielle Morrison, Ruisheng Liu, Alexander E Kalyuzhny
pmc-12607846.description: Acute kidney injury (AKI) is a leading cause of distant organ dysfunction among critically ill patients. Mitochondrial dysfunction is considered a key factor driving the damage after renal ischemia–reperfusion (IR) injury. Damaged mitochondria release mitochondrial damage-associated molecular patterns (mtDAMPs) into the cytosol, which initiate a systemic inflammatory response.

pmc-13271947.title: The impact of statin therapy on the prognosis of hormone receptor-positive breast cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13271947.creator: Xiaowen Ma, Yiming Sun, Yaqin Qi, Hiajiang Qu, Feng Zhang
pmc-13271947.description: BackgroundStatins are increasingly recognized for their potential to reduce endocrine therapy resistance and improve overall survival in breast cancer. However, their specific prognostic impact on hormone receptor-positive (HR+) breast cancer remains incompletely understood. This study aims to evaluate the effect of statin use on recurrence and mortality in HR+ breast cancer patients through a comprehensive meta-analysis.

pmc-13397885.title: Plasmon Engineering in Intercalated 2H-TaS2
pmc-13397885.creator: Luigi Camerano, Laura Martella, Lorenzo Battaglia, Federico Giannessi, Filippo Camilli, Luca Lozzi, Polina M. Sheverdyaeva, Paolo Moras, Luca Ottaviano, Gianni Profeta, Federico Bisti
pmc-13397885.description: Plasmons in low-dimensional materials provide a powerful platform for nanoscale control of light–matter interactions, yet strategies to tailor their coherence and dissipation remain limited. Here, we demonstrate that transition-metal intercalation offers a fundamentally distinct route to engineer plasmonic response in layered materials.

pmc-13422817.title: Association between organisational patient safety practices, safety culture and adverse event reporting in paediatric emergency departments in Spain: a multicentre cross-sectional survey study
pmc-13422817.creator: Blanca Collado-González, María Victoria Navarta-Sánchez, Ancor Sanz-Garcia, Ana María Palmar-Santos, Emergency Safety Culture Group

pmc-13587907.title: Modelling beyond additive risks: A framework for estimating the cascading burden of environmental exposure
pmc-13587907.creator: Jinting Guo, Hengyi Liu, Meng Wang, Mingkun Tong, Jianyu Deng, Ning Kang, Tianjia Guan, Tao Xue, Tong Zhu
pmc-13587907.description: Standard models for assessing the acute health effects of environmental exposures assume that risks from daily exposures are additive, ignoring “cascading effects” where prior events modify an individual’s vulnerability. Here, we introduce and validate the Interactive Distributed Lag Model (iDLM), which quantifies these dynamics by incorporating interaction terms between exposures at different lags.

pmc-13633417.title: The feline sacroiliac joint: An overview of its innervation and morphology
pmc-13633417.creator: Alexandra S. Klick, Thomas Grochow, Mirjam Kalusa, Simone A. Fietz, Christoph K. W. Mülling, Nicole Röhrmann
pmc-13633417.description: The sacroiliac joint (SIJ) serves as a central interface for force transmission from the hindlimbs to the axial skeleton in animals of all species. Its specialized morphology reflects this functional requirement, comprising a smooth auricular surface and a rugose tuberosity covered by interosseous ligaments.
